front.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
front.tldr: César de la Fuente's lab is using Codex and ChatGPT to mine living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections, one of medicine's biggest looming threats.

front.title: Apple extends free iPhone satellite access for another year
front.tldr: Apple is giving existing iPhone owners another free year of satellite features, revealed quietly in a footnote to the iPhone 18 Pro press release.

front.title: Being Heumann Review: Siân Heder's CODA Follow-Up Is an Essential Biopic
front.tldr: Siân Heder's first film since CODA is a biopic of disability rights activist Judy Heumann, praised at Toronto for being life-affirming and boasting a strong lead performance from Ruth Madeley.

stories.title: Introducing the Agents API
stories.tldr: OpenAI has launched the Agents API, a managed service built on its Codex harness for orchestrating cloud agents, long-running sessions and tool use.

stories.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT-Live-1 in the API
stories.tldr: OpenAI's new GPT-Live-1 model brings full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with better instruction-following, custom voices and telephony support.

stories.title: Meta's AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
stories.tldr: Meta's new AI agent app Muse has climbed to number two on the US app charts, though it is off to a slower start than Meta AI or Threads.

stories.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
stories.tldr: OpenAI has paused new sign-ups for its Pro subscription tier because Astra demand is straining its systems, while it adds more capacity.

stories.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
stories.tldr: Nvidia's Jensen Huang expects another year of strong growth, around 70%, and insists the company's web of AI deals is not circular despite scepticism.

stories.title: A native Gemini app is finally available for Windows PCs
stories.tldr: Google has launched a native Gemini app for Windows, complete with a keyboard shortcut to open it, matching the Mac version.

stories.title: The Boring Company raises $3B in round led by UAE
stories.tldr: Elon Musk's Boring Company has raised $3 billion in a round led by the UAE, and plans to dig more than 150 kilometres of tunnels there.

stories.title: Google is making it easier to switch between password managers on Android
stories.tldr: Google's new Android feature lets users move their passkeys when switching password managers, removing a longstanding lock-in headache.

stories.title: Yoto just announced two new audio devices for kids
stories.tldr: Yoto has announced two new audio devices for children, with upgrades that make them more capable and easier for small hands to use.

stories.title: Proxima Fusion bets €140M on a critical fusion ingredient dominated by Asian suppliers
stories.tldr: Fusion startup Proxima Fusion plans to build a €140 million factory making a key superconducting material, reducing its reliance on Asian suppliers.

stories.title: Apple now accepting App Store submissions built for iOS 27, macOS 27, more
stories.tldr: Apple has opened App Store submissions for apps built for iOS 27 and its other new operating systems, ahead of their public release next Monday.

stories.title: Apple's OS 27 Updates Will Be Released on Monday, 14 September
stories.tldr: Apple has confirmed that iOS 27, macOS 27 and its other operating system updates will launch on Monday 14 September.

stories.title: T-Mobile to Charge $5 a Month for iOS 27 iPhone Handoff
stories.tldr: T-Mobile will charge $5 a month for iPhone Handoff, the new iOS 27 feature that lets one phone number work across two iPhones over eSIM.

stories.title: Apple Rates iPhone 18 Pro Slightly Easier to Repair Than 17 Pro
stories.tldr: Apple's own repairability scores rate the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max as slightly easier to repair than last year's iPhone 17 Pro models.

stories.title: The Criterion Collection Just Got Its First Physical Outpost in Toronto
stories.tldr: The Criterion Collection has opened its first physical shop, Cinema Cellar, in Toronto to coincide with the film festival there.

stories.title: Rapinoe Review: Doc Portrait of American Soccer Icon Is Engaging and Inspiring
stories.tldr: A new documentary on Megan Rapinoe, debuting at the Toronto Film Festival, is engaging and inspiring as it reflects on her career since retiring in 2023.

stories.title: Steve Carell Almost Played The Office Creator Greg Daniels' Dad in Biopic About the 1968 Olympics
stories.tldr: Steve Carell nearly played the father of The Office creator Greg Daniels in a biopic about the 1968 Olympics, after the two grew close making the show.

stories.title: Toronto's New Film Market Opens With Werner Herzog, Tom Hanks and a Zack Snyder Passion Project
stories.tldr: Toronto's new film market has launched, with buzz around a Werner Herzog and Tom Hanks project and a Zack Snyder passion project among the titles for sale.

stories.title: Michael Carrick reflects on Manchester United's 4-0 Champions League return
stories.tldr: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick discussed the club's 4-0 win in their return to the Champions League.

stories.title: Christian Gonzalez reacts to record-breaking contract extension: I love Boston
stories.tldr: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez said he loves Boston and wants to stay, after signing a record-breaking contract extension with New England.

stories.title: Robert Kraft Elected to Sports Broadcasting Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Patriots chairman and CEO Robert Kraft has been elected to the Sports Broadcasting Hall of Fame, recognising decades of leadership that reshaped the NFL's media landscape.

stories.title: Leclerc takes blame for Hamilton clash at Monza after Ferrari talks
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc has admitted he didn't behave as he should have towards Ferrari team mate Lewis Hamilton at Monza, and the pair have since talked it through.

stories.title: Max Verstappen makes Red Bull seat joke after Robin Raikkonen signing
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen joked he might eventually have to give up his Red Bull seat, after the team signed junior driver Robin Raikkonen.

stories.title: First pictures of the Madring, Spain's new Formula 1 circuit
stories.tldr: F1 drivers got their first look at the completed Madring circuit in Madrid, ahead of practice for the sport's inaugural Spanish Grand Prix there this weekend.

stories.title: 5 story lines to follow as the Red Sox move toward the end of the regular season
stories.tldr: With the Red Sox easing toward the end of the regular season, Boston.com highlights the trends worth following, including Roman Anthony and Sonny Gray.

read.why: OpenAI launched its Agents API today, so this back-catalogue guide to building and living with a team of personal AI agents feels timely.
read.title: OpenClaw: The complete guide to building, training, and living with your personal AI agent
read.subtitle: I built a team of 9 AI agents that run my work and life. Here's how you can too.

listen.why: Thiel's playbook for building a monopoly through a genuinely different product is a fitting listen on a day full of competing AI agent launches.
listen.title: #424 Peter Thiel on How to Build a Creative Monopoly

listen.why: DHH on building a profitable company without losing control speaks directly to running small software products your own way.
listen.title: DHH: How to Build a Profitable Company Without Losing Control

listen.why: Acquired's deep dive into Costco is a masterclass in the kind of disciplined, product-first operating Damian studies.
listen.title: Costco

finally.title: 2,977 drones used to recreate Twin Towers for 9/11 anniversary
finally.tldr: Design studio Drift and architect Shigeru Ban recreated the Twin Towers using 2,977 drones, one light for each life lost, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.
